name: Cedar Learning Days
summary: A public programme identity that makes dates, session choices and practical attendance information easy to carry and scan.

palette.name: Background
palette.evidence: Native Office page/sheet white ground; explicit design choice retaining the reading surface.

palette.name: Text
palette.evidence: used style Normal explicit text color

palette.name: Programme header
palette.evidence: Native reference.docx word/document.xml active shading/border value #333333; source visual and native-design-style-audit corroboration.

palette.evidence: Native reference.docx word/document.xml active shading/border value #F2F5F7; source visual and native-design-style-audit corroboration.

typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source used style Title.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source used style Subtitle.

recognitionRules: Keep the event name, dates and short programme promise at the top.
Pair Georgia headings with Calibri programme detail.
Align session time, title and practical notes in a consistent reading order.
Keep black-on-white print clarity across A4 and companion print editions.

principles: Use short action sentences; follow an invitation with a concrete material, choice or check.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Find a session that fits. Bring a question. Leave time to try.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid promises that every participant will master the skill.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Try one version, then compare it with the criterion.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use CEDAR LEARNING DAYS as a Georgia wordmark with the dates in a smaller Calibri line. No tree emblem is required.
invariants: Keep the event name, dates and short programme promise at the top.
Pair Georgia headings with Calibri programme detail.
Align session time, title and practical notes in a consistent reading order.
adaptations: A4 and alternate print formats share the same identity and content hierarchy.
Change page breaks to fit the paper, never shrink essential access text.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Georgia is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.
Calibri is a separately licensed Microsoft/Office font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
